categories.description: The run changes protected paths, future content, canon, or publish state without current authority.
Story, perspective, metaphor, player verb, or intended ambiguity is contradicted or obscured.
Camera, input, pacing, or transition steals, strands, or ambiguously returns control.

A required objective lacks actionable work-order copy, an exact live marker match, accessible semantic feedback, lifecycle-clear behavior, or parity across supported variants. Route copy and player verbs to Chapter, feedback causality to Score, hierarchy and occlusion to Cinematography, and wiring or lifecycle failures to Integration.
The intended subject is not the first legible read or is defeated by blocking, crop, clutter, HUD, or procedural variation.
A cut, FOV, rig, screen direction, motion, easing, or hand-back is unjustified, discontinuous, or not reset.
Semantic palette roles, light, fog, materials, sky, water, or grade cease to describe one continuous atmosphere.
A render effect reveals unearned fidelity, lacks perceptual meaning, hides weak composition, or reduces the scene to generic cinematic styling.
Harmonic authority, voice leading, motif, era instrumentation, arrangement, silence, or mix loses musical coherence.
Story, score, camera, caption, effect, or control references duplicated timing or lands away from its shared anchor.
Mobile, reduced-motion, or lower-quality variants change story meaning, focal subject, readability, or control safety.
The scene misses frame/audio budgets, leaks state, breaks sandbox, or regresses build, flow, reset, or persistence.
Evidence is stale, coarse, partial, self-reviewed, missing variants, or too thin to support approval.
A material peer objection or taste thesis was ignored, self-closed, or flattened rather than dispositioned.
